scope: First expert-system substrate for N1000-N3000. It creates deterministic evidence states, not final performance judgements or recommendations.
confidence_semantics: confidence=1.0 means the stored state follows deterministically from the available inputs and rule. It is not a calibrated probability and does not mean that a player is good/bad or that a change is meaningful.
principles: No arbitrary minimum-match threshold is introduced in EXPERT-01.
No rating, weight, percentile, good/bad label or final recommendation is introduced in EXPERT-01.
N3000 uses only FEATURE-02 strict-past primitives, so current or future matches never enter the historical baseline.
The zero boundary is used only as the mathematical sign of an exact difference or slope, not as a claim of practical significance.
ABOVE_PRIOR_MEAN is descriptive only: for harmful metrics such as turnovers, above is not automatically better.
Missing or insufficient evidence is represented explicitly instead of being imputed.

families.name: availability_activity_observed
families.interpretation: Observed participation/listing state only. It does not infer injury, medical availability or fitness.

families.name: structural_role_observed
families.interpretation: Observed role label only. Player archetypes and role-fit scores are deferred.

families.name: current_vs_strict_past_mean
families.interpretation: Direction relative to the player's own strict-past mean; no practical-significance threshold is claimed.

families.name: strict_past_trend_direction
families.interpretation: Mathematical direction of the OLS slope over prior non-null observations only. It is not yet a semantic improving/declining label.
